sections.title: Grammar — be going to / present continuous
sections.titleUz: Grammatika — be going to / present continuous

exercises.instructionEn: Look at Tom's arrangements, then, in pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Tomning belgilangan ishlariga qarang, so'ng juftlikda namunadagidek savol berib, javob bering.
exercises.explanationUz:
TOMNING KUNDALIGI:

     SATURDAY 4th JULY
     ─────────────────────────────────────
     10 am:  visit the dentist
     11 am:  meet Frank for coffee
      1 pm:  have lunch with Jane
      5 pm:  catch the train to London


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  SA: 'What IS Tom DOING at ten o'clock?'
  SB: 'He'S VISITING the dentist at ten o'clock.'


NEGA PRESENT CONTINUOUS:
  Bu ishlar KUNDALIKKA yozilgan — ya'ni
  QAT'IY BELGILANGAN (fixed arrangements).
  Har birining ANIQ SOATI bor.

  93-betdagi qoida: aniq vaqt bor →
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

  'He's GOING TO visit the dentist' bo'lsa —
  shunchaki niyat bo'lardi, kundalikka
  yozilmagan bo'lardi.


QOLIP:
  SAVOL:  What IS + ega + DOING at [soat]?
  JAVOB:  ega + 'S + fe'l-ING + at [soat].


BARCHA TO'RT SAVOL-JAVOB:

  1  SA: What is Tom doing at ten o'clock?
     SB: He's visiting the dentist at ten
         o'clock.                      (NAMUNA)

  2  SA: What is Tom doing at eleven o'clock?
     SB: He's meeting Frank for coffee at eleven
         o'clock.

  3  SA: What is Tom doing at one o'clock?
     SB: He's having lunch with Jane at one
         o'clock.

  4  SA: What is Tom doing at five o'clock?
     SB: He's catching the train to London at five
         o'clock.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  1  Tom soat o'nda nima qiladi? —
     Soat o'nda tish shifokoriga boradi.
  2  Tom soat o'n birda nima qiladi? —
     Soat o'n birda Frank bilan qahva ichgani
     uchrashadi.
  3  Tom soat birda nima qiladi? —
     Soat birda Jeyn bilan tushlik qiladi.
  4  Tom soat beshda nima qiladi? —
     Soat beshda Londonga poyezdga chiqadi.


DIQQAT — 'VISIT THE DENTIST':
  'visit the dentist' = tish shifokoriga bormoq.
  'the dentist' — ANIQ artikl bilan
  ('a dentist' emas), chunki bu turg'un ibora.
  Shunday: 'go to the doctor', 'go to the
  dentist'.

DIQQAT — 'CATCH THE TRAIN':
  'catch a train / bus / plane' = poyezdga
  (avtobusga, samolyotga) chiqmoq, ulgurmoq.
  'to catch' = ushlamoq, lekin transport bilan
  'ulgurib chiqmoq' ma'nosida.
  Aksi: 'to MISS the train' (poyezdni boy bermoq).

DIQQAT — 'MEET sb FOR sth':
  'meet Frank FOR coffee' = Frank bilan qahva
  ichgani uchrashmoq.
  'for' bu yerda MAQSADNI bildiradi.

DIQQAT — SOATLARNI O'QISh:
  10 am → 'ten o'clock' (ertalabki 10)
  11 am → 'eleven o'clock'
   1 pm → 'one o'clock' (kunduzgi 1)
   5 pm → 'five o'clock'
  'am' = tushdan oldin, 'pm' = tushdan keyin.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  an arrangement = belgilangan ish, kelishuv
  a dentist      = tish shifokori
  to catch a train = poyezdga chiqmoq
  am / pm        = tushdan oldin / tushdan keyin

exercises.instructionUz: be going to va present continuous (2-qism)
exercises.explanationUz:
93-BETDAGI QUTINING DAVOMI.

93-betda o'rgangan edik:
  BE GOING TO       →  reja va niyat
  PRESENT CONTINUOUS →  qat'iy belgilangan ish

BU BETDA YANA IKKI VAZIFA:

  • 'We also use BE GOING TO for PREDICTIONS
     BASED ON EVIDENCE IN THE PRESENT.'
    = 'be going to' ni HOZIRGI DALILGA asoslangan
      bashorat uchun ham ishlatamiz.

  • 'We also use the PRESENT CONTINUOUS for
     ACTIONS HAPPENING NOW, at the moment of
     speaking.'
    = 'present continuous' ni HOZIR, gapirayotgan
      paytda sodir bo'layotgan harakat uchun ham
      ishlatamiz.


KITOBDAGI IKKI RASM:

  CHAP RASM — be going to: DALIL
     Odam osmonga qaraydi, osmonda QORA BULUTLAR.
     'There are dark clouds in the sky.
      IT'S GOING TO RAIN.'
     (Osmonda qora bulutlar bor.
      Yomg'ir yog'adi.)
     → Yomg'ir HALI YOG'MAGAN, lekin DALIL bor
       (qora bulutlar) → 'be going to'.

  O'NG RASM — present continuous: HOZIR
     Xuddi shu odam, endi soyabon ostida,
     yomg'ir yog'moqda.
     'IT'S RAINING.'
     (Yomg'ir yog'yapti.)
     → Yomg'ir HOZIR yog'moqda → present
       continuous.


ENDI 'BE GOING TO' NING IKKI VAZIFASI BOR:

  1) REJA va NIYAT (93-bet)
     'I'm going to start a computer course.'
     → o'zim hal qilganman

  2) DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT (94-bet)
     'It's going to rain.'
     → osmonda qora bulutlar bor (KO'RINIB
       TURIBDI)


VA 'PRESENT CONTINUOUS' NING HAM IKKI VAZIFASI:

  1) QAT'IY BELGILANGAN kelajak ishi (93-bet)
     'We're leaving on 1st June.'
     → chipta olingan

  2) HOZIR sodir bo'layotgan harakat (94-bet)
     'It's raining.'
     → ayni damda


QANDAY AJRATISh — ENG SODDA USUL:

  Harakat HOZIR sodir bo'layaptimi?
     HA   →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS ('It's raining')
     YO'Q →  hali bo'lmagan:
              vaqti belgilanganmi?
                 HA   → PRESENT CONTINUOUS
                        ('We're leaving on 1st June')
                 YO'Q → BE GOING TO
                        ('It's going to rain')


QO'ShIMChA MISOLLAR — DALILGA ASOSLANGAN BAShORAT:

  'Look at that car! It'S GOING TO crash!'
     (Ana u mashinaga qara! U urilib ketadi!)
     → dalil: mashina nazoratdan chiqqan

  'She's very pale. She'S GOING TO faint.'
     (U juda oqarib ketgan. Hushidan ketadi.)
     → dalil: rangi oqargan

  'The team is playing badly. They'RE GOING TO
   lose.'
     (Jamoa yomon o'ynayapti. Yutqazadi.)
     → dalil: yomon o'yin


DIQQAT — 'WILL' BILAN FARQI:
  'It'S GOING TO rain.'  → DALIL bor (qora bulut)
  'I think it WILL rain.' → shunchaki FIKR, dalil
                            yo'q
  Ikkalasi ham bashorat, lekin asosi boshqa.

points.en: We also use be going to for predictions based on evidence in the present.
points.uz: 'be going to' ni hozirgi dalilga asoslangan bashorat uchun ham ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
DALIL — hozir KO'RINIB turgan narsa.
93-betda o'rgangan vazifasi: reja va niyat.

points.en: There are dark clouds in the sky. It's going to rain.
points.uz: Osmonda qora bulutlar bor. Yomg'ir yog'adi.
points.noteUz:
Yomg'ir HALI YOG'MAGAN.
DALIL: qora bulutlar.
Chap rasmda odam osmonga qaraydi.

points.en: We also use the present continuous for actions happening now, at the moment of speaking.
points.uz: 'present continuous' ni hozir, gapirayotgan paytda sodir bo'layotgan harakat uchun ham ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
93-betda o'rgangan vazifasi:
qat'iy belgilangan kelajak ishi.

Yomg'ir HOZIR yog'moqda.
O'ng rasmda xuddi shu odam soyabon ostida.

points.en: be going to: evidence that something is going to happen
points.uz: be going to: biror narsa sodir bo'lishining dalili
present continuous: hozir sodir bo'layotgan harakat

points.en: It's going to rain. (evidence) ↔ I think it will rain. (just an opinion)
points.uz: Yomg'ir yog'adi (dalil bor) ↔ Menimcha yomg'ir yog'adi (shunchaki fikr).
points.noteUz:
'be going to' — DALILGA asoslangan,
'will' — shunchaki fikr yoki taxmin.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and the prompts. In pairs, ask and answer questions, as in the example. Finally, write a sentence about each picture.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga va ko'rsatmalarga qarang. Juftlikda namunadagidek savol berib, javob bering. Nihoyat, har bir rasm haqida gap yozing.
exercises.explanationUz:
BESh KO'RSATMA:
  she/wash the car
  he/have a bath
  she/drink some orange juice
  he/paint the house
  they/play football

O'N RASM — HAR KO'RSATMA UChUN IKKITA:
  TOQ raqamli rasm (1, 3, 5, 7, 9):
     harakat HALI BOShLANMAGAN → BE GOING TO
  JUFT raqamli rasm (2, 4, 6, 8, 10):
     harakat HOZIR sodir bo'lmoqda →
     PRESENT CONTINUOUS


KITOBDAGI NAMUNALAR:
  Picture 1:  SA: 'What's she GOING TO do?'
              SB: 'She's GOING TO wash the car.'
  Picture 2:  SA: 'What's she DOING?' ...

  DIQQAT: SAVOL ham o'zgaradi!
     toq rasm  →  'What's she GOING TO do?'
     juft rasm →  'What's she DOING?'


RASMLARDA NIMA KO'RINADI:

   1  Ayol chelak bilan mashina yonida turibdi
      (hali yuvishni boshlamagan)
   2  Ayol shimchani mashinaga surtib, yuvyapti

   3  Qiz apelsin sharbatini stakanga quyyapti
      (hali ichmagan)
   4  Qiz stakandan ichyapti

   5  Erkak vanna jo'mragini ochyapti
      (suv to'ldiryapti)
   6  Erkak ko'pikli vannada yotibdi

   7  Ikki bola futbol formasida, qo'llarida
      to'p — maydonga chiqmoqchi
   8  Bolalar maydonda futbol o'ynashyapti

   9  Erkak bo'yoq bankasi va valik bilan uy
      tomon ketyapti, yonida narvon
  10  Erkak valik bilan devorni bo'yayapti


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  She's going to wash the car.          (NAMUNA)
   2  She's washing the car.
   3  She's going to drink some orange juice.
   4  She's drinking some orange juice.
   5  He's going to have a bath.
   6  He's having a bath.
   7  They're going to play football.
   8  They're playing football.
   9  He's going to paint the house.
  10  He's painting the house.


SAVOL-JAVOBLAR (juftlikda):

   1  SA: What's she going to do?
      SB: She's going to wash the car.
   2  SA: What's she doing?
      SB: She's washing the car.
   3  SA: What's she going to do?
      SB: She's going to drink some orange juice.
   4  SA: What's she doing?
      SB: She's drinking some orange juice.
   5  SA: What's he going to do?
      SB: He's going to have a bath.
   6  SA: What's he doing?
      SB: He's having a bath.
   7  SA: What are they going to do?
      SB: They're going to play football.
   8  SA: What are they doing?
      SB: They're playing football.
   9  SA: What's he going to do?
      SB: He's going to paint the house.
  10  SA: What's he doing?
      SB: He's painting the house.


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
   1  U mashinani yuvmoqchi.
   2  U mashinani yuvyapti.
   3  U apelsin sharbati ichmoqchi.
   4  U apelsin sharbati ichyapti.
   5  U vannaga tushmoqchi.
   6  U vannada yotibdi.
   7  Ular futbol o'ynamoqchi.
   8  Ular futbol o'ynashyapti.
   9  U uyni bo'yamoqchi.
  10  U uyni bo'yayapti.


DIQQAT — 'THEY' BILAN 'ARE':
  7 va 8-rasmlarda ega KO'PLIK ('they') →
     'They ARE going to play' → 'They're going
      to play'
     'They ARE playing' → 'They're playing'


DIQQAT — 'HAVE A BATH':
  'have a bath' = vannaga tushmoq, cho'milmoq.
  Britaniya varianti; Amerikada 'take a bath'.
  DIQQAT: 'a bath' — artikl BOR.

DIQQAT — 'PAINT THE HOUSE':
  'to paint' = bo'yamoq (rasm chizmoq ma'nosi
  ham bor).
  Bu yerda uy bo'yash haqida.

DIQQAT — 'SOME ORANGE JUICE':
  'juice' — SANALMAYDIGAN ot → 'some' bilan.
  'a juice' odatda aytilmaydi (faqat 'a glass of
  juice').


ENG MUHIM DARS:
  Bir xil harakat IKKI xil shaklda beriladi —
  farq faqat VAQTDA:
     hali boshlanmagan  →  BE GOING TO
     hozir sodir bo'lmoqda →  PRESENT CONTINUOUS

exercises.instructionEn: In two teams, take it in turns to answer your teacher's questions. Each correct answer gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoaga bo'linib, navbat bilan o'qituvchining savollariga javob bering. Har bir to'g'ri javob uchun bir ochko. Eng ko'p ochko to'plagan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  Teacher:     'Look at picture 1. IS SHE WASHING
                the car?'
  Team A S1:   'NO, SHE ISN'T. She'S GOING TO wash
                the car.'


O'YIN QOIDASI:
  O'qituvchi rasm haqida HA/YO'Q savoli beradi.
  Jamoa TUZATIB javob beradi.


JAVOB QOLIPI — IKKI QISM:
  1) 'No, she isn't.' / 'No, they aren't.'
     (qisqa inkor javob)
  2) 'She's going to wash the car.'
     (to'g'ri shakl)


NEGA 1-RASM UChUN 'NO':
  1-rasmda ayol chelak bilan TURIBDI —
  hali yuvishni BOSHLAMAGAN.
  Demak 'Is she washing?' → YO'Q.
  To'g'risi: 'She's GOING TO wash.'


BARCHA O'N RASM UChUN SAVOL-JAVOB:

   1  T: Is she washing the car?
      A: No, she isn't. She's going to wash the
         car.                            (NAMUNA)

   2  T: Is she going to wash the car?
      A: No, she isn't. She's washing the car.

   3  T: Is she drinking some orange juice?
      A: No, she isn't. She's going to drink some
         orange juice.

   4  T: Is she going to drink some orange juice?
      A: No, she isn't. She's drinking some orange
         juice.

   5  T: Is he having a bath?
      A: No, he isn't. He's going to have a bath.

   6  T: Is he going to have a bath?
      A: No, he isn't. He's having a bath.

   7  T: Are they playing football?
      A: No, they aren't. They're going to play
         football.

   8  T: Are they going to play football?
      A: No, they aren't. They're playing
         football.

   9  T: Is he painting the house?
      A: No, he isn't. He's going to paint the
         house.

  10  T: Is he going to paint the house?
      A: No, he isn't. He's painting the house.


DIQQAT — QISQA JAVOBDA ega VA 'BE' FAQAT:
     'No, she ISN'T.'      ✓
     'No, she isn't washing.'  — to'liq, lekin
                                 qisqa javob emas
     'No, she doesn't.'    ✗ ('do' KERAK EMAS)

DIQQAT — KO'PLIK EGA BILAN:
     7, 8-rasmlar: 'they' → 'No, they AREN'T.'

patterns.formula: What IS + ega + DOING at [soat]?  —  ega + 'S + fe'l-ING at [soat].
patterns.exampleEn: What is Tom doing at ten o'clock? — He's visiting the dentist at ten o'clock.
patterns.exampleUz: Tom soat o'nda nima qiladi? — Soat o'nda tish shifokoriga boradi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Kundalikka yozilgan, ANIQ SOATI bor ish →
PRESENT CONTINUOUS.

patterns.formula: [DALIL]. ega + is/are GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: There are dark clouds in the sky. It's going to rain.
patterns.exampleUz: Osmonda qora bulutlar bor. Yomg'ir yog'adi.
patterns.explanationUz:
HOZIRGI DALILGA asoslangan bashorat.
Avval dalil, keyin bashorat.

patterns.formula: What's she GOING TO do?  ↔  What's she DOING?
patterns.exampleEn: What's she going to do? — She's going to wash the car. / What's she doing? — She's washing the car.
patterns.exampleUz: U nima qilmoqchi? — Mashinani yuvmoqchi. / U nima qilyapti? — Mashinani yuvyapti.
patterns.explanationUz:
Harakat hali boshlanmagan → 'going to'.
Hozir sodir bo'lmoqda → present continuous.
SAVOL ham shunga qarab o'zgaradi.

patterns.formula: Is she + fe'l-ING ?  —  No, she isn't. She's GOING TO + ASOSIY fe'l.
patterns.exampleEn: Is she washing the car? — No, she isn't. She's going to wash the car.
patterns.exampleUz: U mashinani yuvyaptimi? — Yo'q. U mashinani yuvmoqchi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Qisqa javob + TUZATISH.
'be' fe'li bilan — 'do' KERAK EMAS.
